name: Backlight & Display Brightness Control
shortDesc: Utilities to adjust internal laptop displays and external monitor brightness.
detailedDesc: Allows smooth keyboard backlight and monitor dimming.

phase.title: Audio, Hardware & Connectivity
phase.description: PipeWire audio stack, Bluetooth, NetworkManager, screen brightness, and power management.

packages.name: brightnessctl (Recommended)
packages.description: Lightweight CLI tool that controls device backlight without requiring root permissions via udev rules.

packages.name: asdcontrol
packages.description: Hardware controller for Apple Studio Display and external DDC/CI monitor brightness on Linux.
pros: Controls Apple Studio Display hardware brightness directly
